verdict.rationale: Composio ships an SDK (Python/TS packages verified to install and import), a REST API (openapi.json), and a CLI, all of which can be scripted/invoked headlessly without a UI — sessions are created programmatically (composio.sessions.create) and tools executed via API/CLI, which is exactly the pattern used in CI automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration) and independent confirmation of a fully non-interactive auth flow for headless CI runs.
